About

Creating brands with character, clarity & purpose.

I help emerging food, beverage, and lifestyle founders stand out on crowded shelves and charge what their craft is worth.

I’m Eshaal Syed, an independent Brand Identity Designer and Visual Designer. I take a brand from first idea to a finished identity: the logo, the colours, the type and the rules that keep it consistent.

Each project here began with a different audience and ended with a different personality, from a handcrafted bakery to a calm, dark matcha label.
